title: These 6 Corporations Control 90% Of The Media In America
type: Journalism; reproduces an infographic, not a market-concentration study
findings: Attributes graphic to Jason at Frugal Dad; says graphic was from previous year; includes warning about outdated corporate affiliations. Does not provide a reproducible denominator for all media.
limitations: The article's own ownership correction is not used as a precise account of the Comcast/GE transaction. This source establishes circulation of the six/90 claim, not its validity or earliest origin.

title: Paramount Completes Acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, Creating a New Global Entertainment Leader, Skydance
findings: States acquisition completed October 6; combined company named Skydance; portfolio includes CBS News, CNN, Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and streaming brands. Describes Ellison Family/RedBird voting control.
limitations: Company claims about competition, future savings and consumer benefits are advocacy and forward-looking statements, not independent findings.

title: Versant Media Reports Third Quarter 2026 Operating and Financial Results
findings: Dates separation from Comcast January 2, 2026; describes CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network and related portfolio. Current portfolio cross-checked at https://www.versantmedia.com/about.
limitations: Earnings figures and ratings claims are company statements; report uses this for separation and asset identity, not independent performance comparisons.

title: Fox Corporation Completes Acquisition of Roku
findings: States Roku acquisition completed November 6; identifies Fox News Media, Fox Sports, Fox Entertainment, Fox Television Stations, Roku and Tubi in corporate portfolio.
limitations: Promises about an open ecosystem and future benefits are corporate commitments, not independent proof of future conduct.

title: Our Businesses and Brands
findings: Lists Dow Jones, HarperCollins, News UK, News Corp Australia and New York Post, among other businesses.
limitations: Illustrative corporate portfolio, not market-share or complete beneficial-ownership evidence. Undated current page is not an archived November 11 snapshot.

title: About NBCUniversal
findings: Identifies NBC, NBC News, Telemundo, NBC local stations, Bravo, Peacock and film studios; states NBCUniversal is a Comcast subsidiary.
limitations: Undated page is current-access corroboration, not an archived cutoff-date snapshot. No company audience or leadership marketing claims adopted.

title: iHeartMedia corporate overview and radio-station directory
findings: Describes broadcast radio, networks, podcasts, digital audio and a large owned-station network.
limitations: Company reach and ranking claims are promotional and are not treated as shares of all media. Current page includes October/November 2026 material; not a complete ownership registry.

title: About Us
findings: Describes the Times Company's journalism and publishing operation, separate from the entertainment conglomerates in the old six-company graphic.
limitations: Company statements about journalism quality are not adopted as independent evaluations; this page does not establish a complete shareholder-control map.

title: TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC Established in Compliance with U.S. Regulatory Requirements
findings: Describes independent U.S. joint venture, U.S. moderation/algorithm/data authority, continued global interoperability/commercial functions; managing investors Silver Lake, Oracle and MGX each15%; ByteDance retains19.9%.
limitations: Statement of corporate structure and allocated authority, not independent proof of security effectiveness or political neutrality. Newsroom index saysJanuary23 but article itselfJanuary22; report uses article date.

stats.population: TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC equity
stats.denominator: 100% of joint-venture equity; not all global TikTok assets or all media

title: xAI Joins SpaceX to Accelerate Humanity's Future
findings: Says SpaceX acquired xAI and describes integration with its real-time information platform; SpaceX site lists X among its businesses/services.
limitations: This live updates page also contains later material; only dated February2 section and relevant corporate navigation used. Technical forecasts and promotional claims not adopted.

title: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Financial Report / Form 10-K
publisher: The Walt Disney Company; copy hosted by AnnualReports.com
type: Corporate annual report / SEC filing, mirrored copy
findings: 128-page PDF read locally with pypdf; business section describes ABC Network, Disney+, Hulu, studios and ESPN sports operations. Distinguishes owned ABC stations from affiliates.
limitations: This is an explicitly dated fiscal2025 record, not proof that every asset or minority share remained unchanged throughout2026. Report avoids exact ESPN equity shares or complete current asset inventory.

title: G is for Google
findings: Announces Alphabet holding company, Google as wholly owned subsidiary, and YouTube within Google. Current basic parent relationship cross-checked against O13.
limitations: Historical announcement; not itself a current financial or shareholder-control audit.

title: Alphabet Inc.
type: Secondary reference used for basic current corporate cross-check
findings: Identifies Alphabet as Google's parent and links its2025Form10-K. OriginalSECfiling was inaccessible to browser; report does not claim to have read that filing.
limitations: Editable secondary source. Financial figures, shareholder stakes and other statistics are not used from it. Google2015primaryannouncementandYouTubecorporatedocumentationprovideadditionalcontext.
